title: swertia albicaulis
intro: Swertia albicaulis, commonly known as White-stemmed Swertia, is a perennial plant species in the gentian family (Gentianaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include the treatment of fever, cough, and other respiratory issues due to its health benefits, such as its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Swertia albicaulis include its ability to reduce fever and relieve cough and cold symptoms, making it a useful remedy for respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of Swertia albicaulis include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
